pages.text: A backpack goes in your back slot and opens with $(bold)B$(). Leather, string and two ingots of any common metal (iron, copper, tin, zinc, lead, nickel, aluminium). It can be upgraded and dyed. Supplementaries' sacks are the cheap alternative: a block of storage you can carry.
pages.title: Backpack

pages.text: $(bold)Shulker boxes$() are late. Before them: sacks, backpacks, chest minecarts, wagons, ships. Create's chutes and belts move things between machines; wagons move them between towns.$(br2)A $(bold)toolbox$() (Create) holds tools and swaps them into your hand.
Toolboxes are shared within range: open one and your hotbar can pull from it.

$(bold)Crafting from your chests:$() the $(bold)Proximity Crafting Table$() uses every chest, barrel, drawer and vault within 8 blocks as if it were in your pack. Open it and EMI's craftable filter shows what the room can make; its fill button pulls the ingredients from wherever they are.$(br2)It works in your own land: it will not reach into land another team has claimed.
Four chests, four common metal ingots (iron, copper, tin, zinc, lead, nickel or aluminium) and a crafting table. Set it in the storeroom.

$(bold)Workshop tables$() (any wood) can open one nearby chest at a time: put a $(bold)name tag$() in the table's side slot and the chests next to it appear as tabs (two name tags on a dual table reach two blocks).$(br2)$(bold)Storage Drawers$() hold one item each in bulk, show it on the front, and feed Create funnels and belts directly.
